objective: Replace QChat's lossy word-presence codec with exact ordered token frames and a compatible native learned readout, then connect verified natural-language requests to existing tools

representation.raw_text: Original UTF-8 retained; NFC lower-case dictionary keys preserve accents and enie. Unknown words receive distinct IDs instead of being removed.
representation.quantum_register: 100 reusable Clifford qubits for each exact frame; VQC3 and QRL3 remain at their existing 1000 qubits each
representation.features: Exact measured word IDs, ordered ID pairs, position/word pairs, history sections and exact output IDs/position. Sparse integer feature keys have disjoint ranges and no lossy hash.
representation.limit_behavior: Explicit unsupported/capacity result; no silent truncation of an accepted frame
representation.cache_upgrade: Preserve measured legacy rows; derive the two role features natively on load. Compare upgraded cache features against fresh circuit encodings.

learning.text_source: Original training curriculum; exact four-word ordered contrasts; training-only history wrappers; one-word training anchors
learning.intent_source: Unique earlier training cases plus four training-only argument substitutions per declared native contract. Contract syntax is known; validation and reserved names/values remain independent.
learning.intent_sampling: Equal per-class updates, ceil(unique samples / classes) each epoch, reshuffled; no duplicated input caches.
learning.scope_features: Exact native define-A-no-B target and negative-request indicator; programmed bounded syntax, learned outputs.
learning.early_stop: First registered validation checkpoint at or above 90 percent in every group. No final-test feedback.

text_seed.candidate_policy: Validate unchanged seed under the head-zero-equivalent source; no further text updates if it passes.

learning.curriculum: Systematic lexical variants of training sentences, balanced unique caches; validation has independent names, values and complete phrasings.
learning.routing_fillers: Native readout masks common articles, punctuation and instruction fillers for the intent head only. Exact raw tokens and text readout are preserved.
learning.intent_bank: A fresh sparse native head (bank 2), while retaining the seed measured input caches and prior bank.
learning.routing_roles: Native first meaningful measured token, independent of leading punctuation/courtesy words; native support indicator from the training-only semantic lexicon.

validation.selection: Validation only, minimum of text, refusal, contrast and intent capability before opening the reserved test
validation.group_definition: Expected intent label, not predicted label; exact generated-token equality with native EOS for text
validation.intent_interpretation: Known contract transfer to independent arguments; not a held-out paraphrase or open-language benchmark.

final_test.status: Unopened; requires every validation family >= 90 percent, complete tools and transaction checks.

compatibility: Original E01/E02/Zero models and user storage retained. New vocabulary, model and codec share a separate versioned identity.
claims: A measured C1 engineering step in specified task families, not a demonstration of general intelligence or quantum advantage
revises: Independent successor; frozen C1 experiment and original product models preserved.
